name: CWLRequirementsMap
abstract: Map-form (keyed by requirement class name) of the requirement types accepted by 'requirements'/'hints', shared between CWLRequirements and CWLHints; not typically profiled on its own.

examples.title: Docker and shell command requirements
examples.content:
Map-form `requirements`/`hints` declaring both a Docker image to run the tool in
and that the tool relies on shell features (redirection, pipes) in its command
line.
